      savePersistentGenome() {
        try {
          const payload = {
            authorityEpoch: this.authorityEpoch,
            simulationTick: this.simulationTick,
            policyCid: this.policyCid,
            checkpointCid: this.checkpointCid,
            bodyRecipe: this.bodyRecipe,
            W_actor: Array.from(this.W_actor).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(5))),
            W_metamorph: Array.from(this.W_metamorph).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(5))),
            W_critic: Array.from(this.W_critic).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(5))),
            W_world: Array.from(this.W_world).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(5))),
            offspringColony: this.offspringColony.slice(0, 4),
            episodicMemory: this.episodicMemory.slice(-30),
            semanticMemory: this.semanticMemory,
            proceduralMemory: this.proceduralMemory,
            handoffLedger: this.handoffLedger.slice(-16),
            dreamReplaysCount: this.dreamReplaysCount,
            pelletsEatenCount: this.pelletsEatenCount,
            horizontalTransfersCount: this.horizontalTransfersCount,
            personality: this.personality,
            emotionState: this.emotionState,
            morphogenesis: this.morphogenesis,
            cognitiveCortex: this.cognitiveCortex,
            visitedUrls: Array.from(this.visitedUrlTabooSet).slice(-160),
            clickedAnchors: Array.from(this.clickedAnchorTabooSet).slice(-160),
            swarmFormation: this.swarmCollective.formationMode,
            sovereignStats: {
              commandsExecutedCount: this.sovereignMaster.commandsExecutedCount,
              vaultEngramsCrystallized: this.sovereignMaster.vaultEngramsCrystallized,
              bookmarksAutonomouslyPinned: this.sovereignMaster.bookmarksAutonomouslyPinned,
              maxsmartDossiersSynthesized: this.sovereignMaster.maxsmartDossiersSynthesized,
              vibeCssMutationsCount: this.sovereignMaster.vibeCssMutationsCount,
              emergentQueriesInjected: this.sovereignMaster.emergentQueriesInjected
            },
            causalPropositions: this.causalGraph.propositions.slice(-48),
            trainableHub: this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub ? {
              W_perc_enc: Array.from(this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub.W_perc_enc).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              W_perc_dec: Array.from(this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub.W_perc_dec).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              W_dyn1: Array.from(this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub.W_dyn1).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              W_dyn2: Array.from(this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub.W_dyn2).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              W_diff1: Array.from(this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub.W_diff1).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              W_diff2: Array.from(this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub.W_diff2).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              W_gen1: Array.from(this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub.W_gen1).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              W_gen2: Array.from(this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub.W_gen2).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              W_disc1: Array.from(this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub.W_disc1).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              W_disc2: Array.from(this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub.W_disc2).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              W_aware16: Array.from(this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub.W_aware16).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              totalBackpropStepsTrained: this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub.totalBackpropStepsTrained,
              ideasSynthesizedCount: this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub.ideasSynthesizedCount,
              dreamConsolidationSteps: this.trainableAlifeNeuralHub.dreamConsolidationSteps
            } : null,
            sltcLearned: this.deepWebAndSltcConnectomeEngine ? {
              sltcWeights64: Array.from(this.deepWebAndSltcConnectomeEngine.sltcWeights64).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              sltcRecWeights64: Array.from(this.deepWebAndSltcConnectomeEngine.sltcRecWeights64).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              sltcBias64: Array.from(this.deepWebAndSltcConnectomeEngine.sltcBias64).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4)))
            } : null,
            aotTotGotLearned: (this.aotTotGotEngine && this.aotTotGotEngine.W_aot_contractor) ? {
              W_aot_contractor: Array.from(this.aotTotGotEngine.W_aot_contractor).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              W_tot_branch4x16x16: Array.from(this.aotTotGotEngine.W_tot_branch4x16x16).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4))),
              W_got_attn: Array.from(this.aotTotGotEngine.W_got_attn).map((v) => Number(v.toFixed(4)))
            } : null,
            portedPantheonLearned: (this.portedMultiverseBrains && typeof this.portedMultiverseBrains.exportLearnedState === 'function')
              ? this.portedMultiverseBrains.exportLearnedState()
              : null,
            authenticAsmodensius: this.authenticAsmodensius ? this.authenticAsmodensius.exportState() : null,
            savedAt: new Date().toISOString()
          };
          localStorage.setItem('humunculus_persistent_genome_v1', JSON.stringify(payload));
        } catch (error) {
          if (this.authenticAsmodensius) this.authenticAsmodensius.lastError = `Checkpoint save failed: ${error.message}`;
          console.warn('Persistent genome save failed; previous stored checkpoint retained:', error.message);
        }
      }
